notes:
Stability release — fixes the crashes that dropped you back to the home screen.

• Fixed crashes when opening the overlay manager with photo or video overlays
• Fixed the app dying after returning from the gallery picker while live
• Fixed the crash when flipping the camera
• The stream no longer stops when a dialog or the notification shade covers the screen
• Fixed the black preview after switching back to the app
• Quality settings now load correctly instead of falling back to defaults
• Lower memory use for image and web overlays
• If the app does close unexpectedly, it now tells you why on the next launch
